description: EuroCrops is the Technical University of Munich research collection that harmonises agricultural parcel declarations across European countries. It supplies country-level parcel shapefiles, crop-code translations and the Hierarchical Crop and Agriculture Taxonomy, whose ten-digit codes relate national labels to a common hierarchy. The reviewed repository lists 17 countries, with coverage years varying by source and release. Public version 11 is available through Zenodo under CC-BY-SA-4.0. A limitation is that declarations are administrative labels, not independent field observations; national categories, reporting coverage and dates differ. The repository also warns that some NUTS3 assignments are approximate and links the separate successor EuroCrops 2. EuroCrops can supply crop-location inputs for irrigation-demand, agricultural exposure and food-supply simulations, complementing subnational yields in CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). The repository documents the taxonomy and file organisation and cites the 2023 Scientific Data paper. This record concerns the original EuroCrops collection, not EuroCropsML or the successor product. No parcel files were downloaded.
